title: X9C-3 Phase E: Service Refactor Pilot Selection
pilot_selection_rationale: Select lowest-risk, highest-impact services for proof-of-concept refactoring. Must have clear scope, few callers, no governance dependencies, and clear path to parameter-based auth.
hard_constraints: NO services with governance/workspace/role logic (blocked on X9D)
NO services with DECISION_CREATE or DECISION_UPDATE calls
NO services with cross-workspace or multi-workspace logic
NO services with complex policy dependencies
Pilots must have auth-guard imports (need refactoring)

candidates_evaluated.refactor_plan: 1. Identify required capabilities (CREATE, UPDATE, VALIDATE). 2. Move capability checks to route. 3. Pass hasCreateCapability, hasUpdateCapability, hasValidateCapability as booleans. 4. Service uses envelope to read capabilities instead of calling requireCapabilityForService. 5. Update 2 route callers. 6. Update tests to pass capability booleans.
reasons: Clean parameter replacement: capability checks -> boolean flags
Can serve as template for similar services

candidates_rejected.reason: REJECTED - Lower priority for initial pilot
candidates_rejected.rejection_notes: Only 1 caller, only 2 expected violations reduction. Lower impact than findings.ts or deliverable.ts. Not rejected for safety, just deprioritized for first pilot.
Dashboard-specific use case, not on critical path. Can be refactored after findings.ts and deliverable.ts pilots succeed.
Services with role/workspace membership logic require X9D workspace design to be finalized. Cannot safely refactor until governance model is clear.
Complex role resolution logic requires X9D clarification. Defer until after X9D workspace/role design complete.
